findings.text: follow-on: the env-URI early return hardcodes bolt_port=BOLT_BASE_PORT and http_port=HTTP_BASE_PORT, whereas the pre-change path derived them from the location via _convention_bolt_port/_convention_http_port (profiles.py:472/483 add get_port_offset). For any configured graph location beyond the first in pyproject.toml's locations list (e.g. jet at index 3), profile.bolt_port therefore changes from 7690 to 7687 whenever NEO4J_URI is set, and the existing guard tests/core/test_graph_profiles.py:124 ("Convention ports still available for service management") only exercises an offset-0 location, so it cannot catch it. It does not block: NEO4J_URI names the endpoint outright, the manifest discloses the field change under evidence_inputs, and the done-when is met.

follow-on: record observation, not a code defect — the reviewed manifest declares tests/graph/test_profiles.py among orientation_write_paths but no such module exists and none was created; the manifest's own follow_ons names this, so a reader of the manifest alone sees the discrepancy only after reading that field.

item_verdicts.diff: read f7eb40d76..c9d8b28db commit by commit (single commit c9d8b28db): profiles.py hoists the env-URI branch ahead of resolve_location into an early return, the two stale comments are corrected, and one new test case plus docstring wording land in test_client_address_resolution.py.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when's three clauses each hold with a recorded artifact: tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py:109 test_explicit_neo4j_uri_survives_an_unreadable_location pins resolve_location to raise and asserts GraphClient().uri == EXPLICIT_URI; tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py:140 test_an_unreadable_location_is_not_swallowed keeps the no-override raise; gate-after.log records 256 passed, 1 skipped, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: plan §11 asks to move the NEO4J_URI check ahead of location resolution in resolve_neo4j; imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:406-425 now returns a Neo4jProfile carrying the env URI before resolve_location is imported or called, so the escape hatch is applied before anything is read.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, gateway tests/test_logs/negative_control_log present, baseline_suite (f7eb40d76, EXIT=0, completed, 0 failures) and after_suite (c9d8b28db, EXIT=0, completed, 0 failures) both carry run-dir log paths, and the evidence_inputs field discloses the env-path port change.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's five declared write paths; the diff touches three of them (imas_codex/graph/profiles.py, tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py, docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/neo4j-uri-before-location.html) and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py:109 asserts client.uri against the module constant EXPLICIT_URI, an independent source rather than a value passed into the code under test, and negative-control.log shows the assertion reds when the env check is moved back after resolve_location; the deduction is that the env-path port change this early return introduces is guarded by no failing test.
justifications.evidence: gate-after.log carries rev c9d8b28db and records 256 passed, 1 skipped, 6 deselected, EXIT=0 against gate-baseline.log's 255 passed (baseline arm at f7eb40d76), and negative-control.log is red with EXIT=1 at the new case, so each done-when clause has its own recorded artifact.
justifications.fit: the early return at imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:415 reuses the module's own Neo4jProfile, BOLT_BASE_PORT/HTTP_BASE_PORT and ACTIVE_LINK idioms and carries a mechanism comment rather than a ticket reference; no plan label, ticket number or author attribution appears in any changed symbol or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:415-425 returns the env URI before line 408's resolve_location call, so the §11 defect where §10's wrapper removal left env applied after the location read is closed, and the no-override raise at line 411 is untouched.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the single owner of profile resolution, imas_codex/graph/profiles.py:resolve_neo4j, and forks no capability; the search over imas_codex/graph and imas_codex/remote/locations found no second NEO4J_URI owner, and get_graph_uri in imas_codex/settings.py remains a thin delegation to it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff f7eb40d76..c9d8b28db touches only imas_codex/graph/profiles.py, tests/graph/test_client_address_resolution.py and the declared evidence fragment, and the comment rewrites in the test docstrings are confined to lines the change already invalidated.
